fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Designer Kristian A. Østby’s site https://evolvinggames.no/ displays this exact Aporta Games 2019 Offshore box beside the game entry. The rulebook credits Knut Løvås for the box cover art. Reduced to 359 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently filled a vehicle with diesel or gasoline starts and takes the active-player marker.
clarifications: That player gives one coin to the player on their right.
internalEvidence: The ©2019 Aporta Games English rules specify the last diesel or gasoline fill, marker, right-neighbor coin, and clockwise turn order on pages 1–2.
